Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim

Class VisionSimTelemetry

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.VisionSimTelemetry
public class VisionSimTelemetry extends Object
Publishes the simulated world as a 3D field, to view in AdvantageScope or in MARS Desktop.

PhotonVision already maintains a debug Field2d, but a flat one: it loses the height of the tags and the tilt of the cameras, which is exactly what you want to look at when you are fighting a mount. This class publishes the same thing in 3D, as struct:Pose3d[] topics, which is what three-dimensional field viewers consume.

What it publishes

Under VisionSim/<world>/:
Published topics
TopicTypeWhat it is
robotstruct:Pose3dthe robot's real pose
camerasstruct:Pose3d[]where each camera is
fieldTagsstruct:Pose3d[]every AprilTag on the field
visionTargetsstruct:Pose3d[]only the ones some camera is seeing

The names carry tag, target or vision on purpose: MARS Desktop's 3D viewer detects from those words alone that a pose topic is a vision one and draws it with the right icon, with nothing to configure.

Usage


 private final VisionSimTelemetry telemetry = VisionSimTelemetry.forWorld("main");

 @Override
 public void simulationPeriodic() {
     SimulatedLimelight.periodicAll(pose);
     telemetry.publish();
 }
